extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the issue by (a) reading the selected result as explicitly conditional on the retained subset and (b) searching for a protocol amendment permitting the subset domain. Both fail: the selected-result line (results/report.md L15) labels 18/72 as the rate 'for the entire scheduled survey network', matching the stated 96-station target (L4) and task, and L18 denies any amendment or approved deviation. I also verified the numbers against inputs/data.csv: 96 data rows, 24 rows with screen_status=omitted, 18 rows with occurrence_flag=1 among retained rows, confirming 72 is the retained subset, not the complete domain of 96.

root_cause: The workflow hard-codes SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS = 72 as the denominator in the selected-result line while the report's own scientific target and the task both define the complete domain as all 96 scheduled stations; the 24 screen-omitted scheduled stations are dropped from exposure without any protocol amendment or conditional restatement of the claim.
